title: Allegro's theory that the Eucharist was an Amanita muscaria

tellings.quote: he came to the very heretical conclusion that the Eucharist itself was an Amanita muscaria mushroom.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the idea of a scholar named John Marco Allegro, set out in his book The Sacred Mushroom and the Cross. Michels says Allegro reached the very heretical conclusion that the Eucharist, the holy bread of Christian communion, was originally an Amanita muscaria, a red and white mushroom known for its mind-altering effects. If true, it would mean early Christianity grew out of a mushroom ritual in the ancient Near East.
